[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Crin Harson]] had a '''wife''', although he also had a [[Crin Harson's mistress|mistress]] on the resort [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tralfin]]. When Harson was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Tralfin, his wife was secretly on planet and was one of the suspects in his death.<ref name="Murder in Paradise" />
